chronological_odyssey.anonymized_text: Unexplained feeling like I have the flu for months and burning neuropathy for months, doctors clueless I've been dealing with feeling like I have the flu for months and constant burning neuropathy. Every blood test comes back normal. Looking for recommendations for a good rheumatologist who actually listens.

Doctor says it's in my head / just anxiety Saw another doctor today. Doctor dismissed my symptoms and said my blood work was completely normal. I feel so hopeless and ignored by the healthcare system.

Years of progressive symptoms (mouth sores and morning stiffness lasting hours) - still no answers It has been so long since this started. Now having mouth sores and morning stiffness lasting hours. My primary care doctor told me it's just anxiety and to do yoga. Exhausted from fighting doctors to be taken seriously. How do you keep advocating for yourself when doctors dismiss everything?

Years of progressive symptoms (extremely dry eyes like sandpaper and muscle weakness) - still no answers It has been so long since this started. Now having extremely dry eyes like sandpaper and muscle weakness. Doctor said my joint pain is just stress from work and refused to run an autoimmune panel. Crying in my car after another useless appointment. Does anyone else feel gaslit? How do you keep advocating for yourself when doctors dismiss everything?
